create_vasp_relax_inputs: run the CLI to generate VASP relaxation input files from a directory of CIF structure files
create_vasp_static_inputs: run the CLI with type static to generate VASP static calculation input files from CIF files
create_input_generator: create a RelaxSetGenerator or StaticSetGenerator from incar YAML settings for VASP input generation
review_create_input_generator: review the create_input_generator function that loads incar YAML settings and returns a VASP set generator
refactor_cif_reading: refactor the CIF file reading loop to handle additional crystal structure file formats beyond CIF
